origin.description: Turn a latex tag list back into source text.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A list of latex nodes with a latex_tag.

origin.details: TEXT after a macro that expects an argument gets a space when it starts with a letter. Math is wrapped in $.
origin.example:
x <- list(structure("\\emph", latex_tag="MACRO"), structure(list(structure("x", latex_tag="TEXT")), latex_tag="BLOCK"))
cat(deparseLatex(x), "\n")

translation.description: Turn a latex tag list back into source text.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A list of latex nodes with a latex_tag.

translation.details: TEXT after a macro that expects an argument gets a space when it starts with a letter. Math is wrapped in $.
translation.example:
from tools.latex import deparse_latex
nodes = [{"tag": "MACRO", "text": "\\emph"}, {"tag": "BLOCK", "body": [{"tag": "TEXT", "text": "x"}]}]
print(deparse_latex(nodes))
